blocks.zh: Section 0: Introduction & General Principles | 簡介與通用原則
blocks.en: Section 0: Introduction & General Principles

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 USP 〈1790〉 的適用範圍，以及它與 〈790〉、〈788〉 等相關章節的關聯
blocks.en: Understand the scope of USP 〈1790〉 and how it relates to 〈790〉, 〈788〉 and other related chapters

blocks.zh: 掌握目視檢查的機率性本質（Probabilistic Nature），以及粒子偵測概率（Probability of Detection, PoD）的影響因素
blocks.en: Understand the probabilistic nature of visual inspection and the factors that influence the Probability of Detection (PoD) of particles

blocks.zh: 熟悉注射劑目視檢查的典型製程流程：100% 檢查 → AQL 驗收抽樣 → 補充測試
blocks.en: Become familiar with the typical process flow for visual inspection of injections: 100% inspection → AQL acceptance sampling → supplemental testing

blocks.zh: 了解檢查生命週期（Inspection Life Cycle）方法，包括外源性、內源性、固有粒子的分類與管理
blocks.en: Understand the Inspection Life Cycle approach, including the classification and management of extrinsic, intrinsic and inherent particles

blocks.zh: 掌握缺陷分類系統：Critical（關鍵）、Major（主要）、Minor（次要）的定義與患者風險對應
blocks.en: Understand the defect classification system: the definitions of Critical, Major and Minor defects and how they map to patient risk

blocks.zh: 1. Scope — 適用範圍
blocks.en: 1. Scope

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 目視檢查的本質
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Nature of Visual Inspection

blocks.zh: Visual Inspection（目視檢查）是注射劑品質管制的最後防線，但它本質上是一個機率性過程，而非確定性過程。這意味著即使是最合格的系統，也無法保證 100% 偵測所有缺陷。
blocks.en: Visual inspection is the last line of defense in injectable quality control, but it is inherently a probabilistic process, not a deterministic one. This means that even the best qualified system cannot guarantee 100% detection of all defects.

blocks.zh: 關鍵影響因子：
blocks.en: Key influencing factors:

blocks.zh: 粒子大小：<100 µm 幾乎無法偵測；≥150 µm 才達到 70% PoD 門檻
blocks.en: Particle size: particles <100 µm are almost undetectable; only particles ≥150 µm reach the 70% PoD threshold

blocks.zh: 粒子特性：形狀、顏色、密度
blocks.en: Particle characteristics: shape, color, density

blocks.zh: 容器特性：透明度、大小、顏色
blocks.en: Container characteristics: clarity, size, color

blocks.zh: 劑型：清澈溶液最易偵測；懸浮液、凍乾品最難
blocks.en: Dosage form: clear solutions are easiest to inspect; suspensions and lyophilized products are the hardest

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 機場安全檢查
blocks.en: Analogy: Airport Security Screening

blocks.zh: 把目視檢查想成機場的 X 光安全檢查：X 光機設備再好，訓練再完善，仍然有偵測不到的違禁品機率，因為同一條行李輸送帶上的包裹密度、角度、遮蔽效應都會影響結果。
blocks.en: Think of visual inspection as an X-ray security check at an airport. However good the machine and however thorough the training, there is still a chance that contraband goes undetected, because the density, orientation and overlap of items on the same conveyor belt all affect the result.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 〈1790〉 強調「預防（Prevention）優先於偵測（Detection）」——最好的策略是從製程源頭減少粒子產生，而非完全依賴檢查來剔除。
blocks.en: This is why 〈1790〉 stresses that prevention takes priority over detection: the best strategy is to reduce particle generation at the source in the process, rather than relying entirely on inspection to remove particles.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 〈1790〉 vs. 〈790〉 的定位
blocks.en: Key Point: The Positioning of 〈1790〉 vs. 〈790〉

blocks.zh: 〈790〉 Visible Particulates in Injections = 規定最低要求（法規強制性）：具體的檢查程序與驗收標準。
blocks.en: 〈790〉 Visible Particulates in Injections = the minimum requirement (mandatory): the specific inspection procedure and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 〈1790〉 Visual Inspection of Injections = 深度指導方針（Informational Chapter）：提供檢查方法、確認、驗證的完整框架，協助業者建立一個合規且有效的系統。
blocks.en: 〈1790〉 Visual Inspection of Injections = in-depth guidance (informational chapter): a complete framework for inspection methods, qualification and validation, to help manufacturers build a compliant and effective system.

blocks.zh: CDMO 應以 〈1790〉 為設計基礎，以 〈790〉 為合規基準。
blocks.en: A CDMO should use 〈1790〉 as the basis for design and 〈790〉 as the benchmark for compliance.

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Difficult-to-Inspect Products (DIP)
blocks.en: Core Concept: Difficult-to-Inspect Products (DIP)

blocks.zh: DIP（難以檢查之產品）是 USP 〈1790〉 中一個重要類別，指那些由於劑型或容器特性，使標準目視檢查靈敏度顯著降低的產品。
blocks.en: DIP (difficult-to-inspect products) is an important category in USP 〈1790〉. It refers to products whose dosage form or container characteristics significantly reduce the sensitivity of standard visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 常見 DIP 類型：
blocks.en: Common DIP types:

blocks.zh: 凍乾品（lyophilized cakes）：固態基質遮蔽粒子
blocks.en: Lyophilized cakes: the solid matrix masks particles

blocks.zh: 懸浮液（suspensions）：固有粒子干擾外來粒子偵測
blocks.en: Suspensions: inherent particles interfere with detection of extraneous particles

blocks.zh: 乳劑（emulsions）：不透明性阻礙視線
blocks.en: Emulsions: opacity obstructs the line of sight

blocks.zh: 琥珀玻璃容器（amber glass）：光線穿透受限
blocks.en: Amber glass containers: limited light transmission

blocks.zh: 塑膠容器（plastic containers）：光學特性差異
blocks.en: Plastic containers: differences in optical properties

blocks.zh: 對於 DIP，需要額外的補充測試（Supplemental Testing）來補充 100% 目視檢查的不足。
blocks.en: For DIP, supplemental testing is needed to compensate for the limitations of 100% visual inspection.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 生命週期方法
blocks.en: Analogy: The Life Cycle Approach

blocks.zh: 把「Inspection Life Cycle（檢查生命週期）」想成一棟大樓的防火系統：最好的防火策略不是只在大樓出口裝灑水器（相當於最終目視檢查），而是從建築材料選用（防火材料）、佈局設計（逃生通道）到例行演習（偵測系統測試）都納入整體考量。
blocks.en: Think of the "Inspection Life Cycle" as the fire protection system of a building. The best fire strategy is not just to put sprinklers at the exits (equivalent to final visual inspection), but to consider the whole picture, from the choice of building materials (fire-resistant materials) and layout design (escape routes) to routine drills (testing of the detection system).

blocks.zh: 同理，目視檢查的生命週期從元件規格制定開始，貫穿整個製造過程，並以持續的趨勢分析結束。
blocks.en: In the same way, the visual inspection life cycle starts with the setting of component specifications, runs through the entire manufacturing process, and ends with ongoing trend analysis.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼說「零缺陷」雖然是目標，但卻不是目視粒子的可行規格（feasible specification）？這對你的 CDMO 批次放行決策有何影響？
blocks.en: Why is "zero defects" a goal but not a feasible specification for visible particulates? What does this mean for your CDMO's batch release decisions?

blocks.zh: 你的設施目前是否有針對 DIP 的補充測試計畫？如何判斷哪些產品需要此類計畫？
blocks.en: Does your facility currently have a supplemental testing program for DIP? How do you decide which products need one?

blocks.zh: RTU 元件（如預洗滌瓶塞、預充填注射器）在檢查生命週期中有何特殊意義？
blocks.en: What is the special significance of RTU components (such as pre-washed stoppers and prefilled syringes) in the inspection life cycle?

blocks.zh: 2. Background — 背景
blocks.en: 2. Background

blocks.zh: 公式與關鍵數據 — PoD vs. 粒子大小
blocks.en: Formula and Key Data: PoD vs. Particle Size

blocks.zh:
粒子大小    PoD (球形粒子，10-mL 清澈玻璃瓶)
─────────────────────────────────────────
50 µm     ≈ 0%（幾乎無法偵測）
100 µm    ≈ 40–60%（灰色地帶）
150 µm    ≈ 70%（可靠偵測門檻 = Reject Zone）
200 µm    > 95%（高確信拒絕）
纖維       ≥ 500 µm 才達到 70% PoD

關鍵意涵：被合格目視檢查系統「漏過」的
非纖維粒子，絕大多數直徑 < 200 µm
blocks.en:
Particle size    PoD (spherical particles, 10-mL clear glass vial)
─────────────────────────────────────────
50 µm     ≈ 0% (practically undetectable)
100 µm    ≈ 40–60% (gray zone)
150 µm    ≈ 70% (reliable detection threshold = Reject Zone)
200 µm    > 95% (high-confidence rejection)
Fibers    ≥ 500 µm to reach 70% PoD

Key implication: the vast majority of non-fiber particles
"missed" by a qualified visual inspection system
are < 200 µm in diameter

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Reject Zone（拒絕區）
blocks.en: Core Concept: Reject Zone

blocks.zh: PoD ≥ 70% 是業界公認的「拒絕區（Reject Zone）」門檻，源自 Knapp & Kushner 方法學（1980年）。這意味著：
blocks.en: PoD ≥ 70% is the industry-accepted threshold for the "Reject Zone", derived from the Knapp & Kushner methodology (1980). This means:

blocks.zh: 達到拒絕區的粒子：在重複檢查中至少 70% 的情況會被偵測到
blocks.en: A particle in the Reject Zone is detected in at least 70% of repeated inspections

blocks.zh: 仍有最多 30% 的機率未被偵測到
blocks.en: There is still up to a 30% chance that it is not detected

blocks.zh: 灰色地帶（Gray Zone）：PoD ≥30% 且 <70%，屬於不確定區域
blocks.en: Gray Zone: PoD ≥30% and <70%, an area of uncertainty

blocks.zh: 這是為什麼目視檢查必須與 AQL 抽樣、趨勢分析並行，形成多層防護。
blocks.en: This is why visual inspection must run in parallel with AQL sampling and trend analysis, to form multiple layers of protection.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 患者風險的差異化思考
blocks.en: Key Point: Differentiated Thinking on Patient Risk

blocks.zh: USP 明確指出：無法用單一標準涵蓋所有患者風險。這對 CDMO 的實務意涵極大：
blocks.en: USP clearly states that no single standard can cover all patient risks. This has major practical implications for a CDMO:

blocks.zh: 高風險族群（早產兒、ICU 患者、靜脈輸液）→ 更嚴格的 AQL，更強的補充測試
blocks.en: High-risk populations (premature infants, ICU patients, intravenous infusions) → stricter AQL and stronger supplemental testing

blocks.zh: 一般成人皮下/肌肉注射 → 標準 AQL 可能足夠
blocks.en: General adult subcutaneous/intramuscular injections → standard AQL may be sufficient

blocks.zh: 給藥途徑：靜脈 > 肌肉/皮下 > 眼科（外用）
blocks.en: Route of administration: intravenous > intramuscular/subcutaneous > ophthalmic (topical)

blocks.zh: 在接受新產品委託時，CDMO 需要與客戶討論目標患者族群，以確立適合的檢查策略。
blocks.en: When accepting a new product, the CDMO needs to discuss the target patient population with the client to establish an appropriate inspection strategy.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 150 µm 的意義
blocks.en: Analogy: What 150 µm Means

blocks.zh: 150 µm 大約是人類頭髮直徑的 1.5 倍（頭髮直徑約 70–100 µm）。換句話說，比頭髮稍粗的粒子才能達到「可靠偵測」的門檻。
blocks.en: 150 µm is about 1.5 times the diameter of a human hair (hair diameter is roughly 70–100 µm). In other words, a particle has to be slightly thicker than a hair to reach the threshold for "reliable detection".

blocks.zh: 這讓我們理解一個關鍵現實：注射劑中任何比這更小的粒子，在標準條件下幾乎是「看不見的」，這正是預防策略（製程控制）比偵測策略更重要的原因。
blocks.en: This helps us grasp a key reality: any particle smaller than this in an injectable is practically "invisible" under standard conditions, which is exactly why a prevention strategy (process control) matters more than a detection strategy.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 接受高風險客戶委託（如兒科 ICU 用靜脈注射劑）時，標準目視檢查流程可能不足。建議額外措施：
blocks.en: When a CDMO takes on a high-risk client product (such as an intravenous injectable for pediatric ICU use), the standard visual inspection flow may not be sufficient. Recommended additional measures:

blocks.zh: 採用更嚴格的 AQL 值（如 Critical: 0.010% 而非 0.10%）
blocks.en: Adopt stricter AQL values (e.g., Critical: 0.010% instead of 0.10%)

blocks.zh: 對 DIP 進行重組後的補充測試
blocks.en: Perform supplemental testing on DIP after reconstitution

blocks.zh: 增加保留樣品的週期性目視檢查頻率
blocks.en: Increase the frequency of periodic visual inspection of retention samples

blocks.zh: 在製程設計中強化上游粒子控制（元件清潔、填充環境）
blocks.en: Strengthen upstream particle control in the process design (component cleaning, filling environment)

blocks.zh: 3. Typical Inspection Process Flow — 典型檢查製程流程
blocks.en: 3. Typical Inspection Process Flow

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — AQL vs. UQL
blocks.en: Core Concept: AQL vs. UQL

blocks.zh: AQL（Acceptable Quality Limit，可接受品質限）：在此缺陷率下，95% 的批次會被接受。AQL 保護的是廠商，防止好批次被錯誤拒絕（生產者風險）。
blocks.en: AQL (Acceptable Quality Limit): the defect rate at which 95% of lots will be accepted. The AQL protects the manufacturer, preventing good lots from being wrongly rejected (producer's risk).

blocks.zh: UQL（Unacceptable Quality Limit，不可接受品質限）：在此缺陷率下，90% 的批次會被拒絕。UQL 保護的是患者/客戶（消費者風險）。
blocks.en: UQL (Unacceptable Quality Limit): the defect rate at which 90% of lots will be rejected. The UQL protects the patient/customer (consumer's risk).

blocks.zh: AQL 0.65% 看起來很嚴格，但如果 UQL 是 5%，表示即使有 5% 的缺陷品，仍有 10% 機率讓批次通過——這才是患者真正面臨的風險。務必查看抽樣計畫的 OC 曲線（Operating Characteristic Curve）。
blocks.en: An AQL of 0.65% looks strict, but if the UQL is 5%, it means that even with 5% defective units there is still a 10% chance that the lot passes. This is the risk patients actually face. Always review the Operating Characteristic (OC) curve of the sampling plan.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 抽樣計畫就像質量控制的保險
blocks.en: Analogy: A Sampling Plan Is Like Insurance for Quality Control

blocks.zh: 把 AQL 抽樣想成火警偵測系統：設定過於靈敏（低 AQL）= 烤吐司就觸發警報（過多假陽性，阻礙生產）；設定不夠靈敏（高 AQL）= 真正火災時反應太慢（患者風險）。
blocks.en: Think of AQL sampling as a fire alarm system: if it is set too sensitive (low AQL) = the alarm goes off when you toast bread (too many false positives, which hinder production); if it is not sensitive enough (high AQL) = it reacts too slowly in a real fire (patient risk).

blocks.zh: 兩段式抽樣計畫（S-3/S-4）的設計，正是在「足夠的偵測力」與「可行的樣本量」之間取得平衡的最佳實踐。
blocks.en: The design of the two-stage sampling plan (S-3/S-4) is best practice for balancing "sufficient detection power" against "a feasible sample size".

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 再檢查（Reinspection）的限制
blocks.en: Key Point: Limits on Reinspection

blocks.zh: USP 明確要求再檢查必須：
blocks.en: USP clearly requires that reinspection must:

blocks.zh: 有品質組織批准的書面程序——不能臨時決定再查
blocks.en: Follow a written procedure approved by the quality unit: reinspection cannot be decided ad hoc

blocks.zh: 限制次數並有充分理由——無限再查等同於操縱數據
blocks.en: Be limited in number and justified: unlimited reinspection amounts to data manipulation

blocks.zh: 兩段式檢查需要驗證——不能假設第二次檢查必然優於第一次
blocks.en: Be validated for two-stage inspection: you cannot assume the second inspection is necessarily better than the first

blocks.zh: 每次再檢查，粒子的 PoD 都會進一步降低（因為粒子可能沉降、溶解）。這是再查次數必須受限的科學依據。
blocks.en: With each reinspection, the PoD of a particle decreases further (because particles may settle or dissolve). This is the scientific basis for limiting the number of reinspections.

blocks.zh: 公式 — 抽樣計畫的實際應用
blocks.en: Formula: Practical Application of a Sampling Plan

blocks.zh:
範例：批次大小 = 50,000 瓶
選擇 S-3 計畫（Normal II）：
  批次範圍 10,001–500,000 → 抽樣代碼 G
  樣本量 n = 20，驗收數 = 0，拒絕數 = 1

意義：抽取 20 瓶，只要發現 1 瓶有缺陷
→ 整批需進入調查流程

如初始 20 瓶中發現 1 瓶有粒子：
→ 轉入 S-4 計畫，再抽 60 瓶（共 80 瓶）
→ 若追加 60 瓶均無粒子 → 批次符合標準
（兩次結果必須合計計算，不得重置）
blocks.en:
Example: lot size = 50,000 vials
Select the S-3 plan (Normal II):
  Lot range 10,001–500,000 → sample size code G
  Sample size n = 20, acceptance number = 0, rejection number = 1

Meaning: sample 20 vials; if even 1 defective vial is found
→ the whole lot goes into the investigation process

If 1 vial with a particle is found in the initial 20:
→ move to the S-4 plan and sample another 60 vials (80 in total)
→ if none of the additional 60 has a particle → the lot meets the standard
(the two results must be counted together, not reset)

blocks.zh: 如果你的 AVI（自動化目視檢查）系統每批次拒絕率突然從 0.3% 上升到 1.5%，你的第一步驟應該是什麼？何時觸發再檢查？何時暫停批次放行？
blocks.en: If the rejection rate of your AVI (automated visual inspection) system suddenly rises from 0.3% to 1.5% per batch, what should your first step be? When do you trigger reinspection? When do you place batch release on hold?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 USP 建議在再檢查後使用「加嚴（tightened）」抽樣計畫，而非正常計畫？這背後的統計邏輯是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does USP recommend using a "tightened" sampling plan rather than a normal plan after reinspection? What is the statistical logic behind this?

blocks.zh: 4. Inspection Life Cycle — 檢查生命週期
blocks.en: 4. Inspection Life Cycle

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 三類粒子的風險矩陣
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Risk Matrix of the Three Particle Types

blocks.zh: 理解三類粒子對 CDMO 的缺陷調查（OOS/OOT）方向至關重要：
blocks.en: Understanding the three particle types is essential for directing a CDMO's defect investigations (OOS/OOT):

blocks.zh: Extrinsic（外源性）：最高警戒等級。來源不明，可能帶有微生物污染風險。每個案例都需完整根本原因分析（RCA）。
blocks.en: Extrinsic: the highest alert level. The source is unknown and there may be a risk of microbial contamination. Every case needs a full root cause analysis (RCA).

blocks.zh: Intrinsic（內源性/製程相關）：可預測，應有預防性控制。多見於金屬磨損、玻璃脫層、矽油。需納入 Contamination Control Strategy（污染控制策略）。
blocks.en: Intrinsic (process-related): predictable, and should have preventive controls. Commonly metal wear, glass delamination and silicone oil. They need to be included in the Contamination Control Strategy.

blocks.zh: Inherent（固有性）：為劑型特性，如蛋白質聚集體。需在開發階段確立驗收標準，並有臨床風險評估支撐。
blocks.en: Inherent: a characteristic of the dosage form, such as protein aggregates. Acceptance criteria need to be established during development and supported by a clinical risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 — 餐廳廚房的衛生管理
blocks.en: Analogy: Hygiene Management in a Restaurant Kitchen

blocks.zh: 把三類粒子想成餐廳廚房的污染來源：
blocks.en: Think of the three particle types as sources of contamination in a restaurant kitchen:

blocks.zh: Extrinsic = 外部帶入的老鼠毛、昆蟲 → 嚴重、不可預測、需立即追查
blocks.en: Extrinsic = rat hair or insects brought in from outside → serious, unpredictable, needs immediate investigation

blocks.zh: Intrinsic = 廚具磨損掉的鐵屑、不鏽鋼碎屑 → 可預測、需設備維護計畫
blocks.en: Intrinsic = iron filings or stainless steel shavings worn off kitchen equipment → predictable, needs an equipment maintenance program

blocks.zh: Inherent = 熟成乳酪的正常結晶、果汁的天然沉澱 → 是產品特性，需標示清楚
blocks.en: Inherent = the normal crystals in aged cheese or the natural sediment in fruit juice → a product characteristic that needs to be clearly labeled

blocks.zh: 重點提示 — 玻璃脫層（Glass Lamellae/Delamination）
blocks.en: Key Point: Glass Lamellae/Delamination

blocks.zh: 玻璃脫層是注射劑製造中最常被 FDA 警告信提及的缺陷之一。關鍵控制點：
blocks.en: Glass delamination is one of the defects most often cited in FDA warning letters on injectable manufacturing. Key control points:

blocks.zh: pH 高於 7 的製劑：腐蝕速率在 pH 8 時比 pH 4 高 25 倍
blocks.en: Formulations with pH above 7: the corrosion rate at pH 8 is 25 times higher than at pH 4

blocks.zh: 高離子強度溶液加速內壁攻擊
blocks.en: High ionic strength solutions accelerate attack on the inner wall

blocks.zh: 玻璃容器製造履歷（Type I vs. 模製 vs. 管製玻璃）影響脫層傾向
blocks.en: The manufacturing history of the glass container (Type I vs. molded vs. tubing glass) affects the tendency to delaminate

blocks.zh: 必須進行玻璃容器內表面耐久性評估（USP 〈1660〉）
blocks.en: The inner surface durability of the glass container must be evaluated (USP 〈1660〉)

blocks.zh: CDMO 在接收新製劑前，應主動詢問客戶的玻璃相容性研究資料。
blocks.en: Before accepting a new formulation, the CDMO should proactively ask the client for its glass compatibility study data.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 — 針刺（Needle Strike）的預防
blocks.en: Practical Application: Preventing Needle Strike

blocks.zh: 「針刺」是 CDMO 填充操作中一個容易被忽視的粒子來源：填充針頭與瓶口接觸時，可能產生不鏽鋼碎屑（來自針頭）或玻璃碎片（來自瓶口損傷）。
blocks.en: "Needle strike" is an easily overlooked source of particles in CDMO filling operations: when the filling needle contacts the vial mouth, it can generate stainless steel fragments (from the needle) or glass chips (from damage to the vial mouth).

blocks.zh: 預防措施：
blocks.en: Preventive measures:

blocks.zh: 填充前的針頭位置驗證（Height Qualification）
blocks.en: Needle position verification before filling (height qualification)

blocks.zh: 填充速度與容積的優化，避免液體噴濺導致物理衝擊
blocks.en: Optimize filling speed and volume to avoid liquid splashing and physical impact

blocks.zh: 定期目視檢查填充針頭的磨損
blocks.en: Regularly inspect the filling needles visually for wear

blocks.zh: 在媒體填充（APS）時特別監測填充站周邊粒子
blocks.en: Specifically monitor particles around the filling station during media fill (APS)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 趨勢分析（Trending）的價值
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Value of Trending

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析是「生命週期方法」的閉環機制。它不僅用於批次放行，更是持續改善的數據引擎：
blocks.en: Trending is the closed-loop mechanism of the life cycle approach. It is used not only for batch release but is also the data engine for continual improvement:

blocks.zh: 100% 檢查數據：反映正常生產的缺陷類型與頻率
blocks.en: 100% inspection data: reflects the defect types and frequencies of normal production

blocks.zh: AQL 數據：驗證 100% 檢查的系統性能
blocks.en: AQL data: verifies the performance of the 100% inspection system

blocks.zh: 警戒/行動限（Alert/Action Levels）：應基於歷史統計，而非固定數字
blocks.en: Alert/Action Levels: should be based on historical statistics, not fixed numbers

blocks.zh: 重要提醒：製程改善後，不應立即降低行動限——需要足夠的生產週期來確認改善效果的持續性。
blocks.en: Important reminder: after a process improvement, action limits should not be lowered immediately; enough production cycles are needed to confirm that the improvement is sustained.

blocks.zh: 你的設施如何區分一顆檢查出的粒子是「外源性」、「內源性」還是「固有性」？這個分類決定了哪些後續行動？
blocks.en: How does your facility determine whether an inspected particle is "extrinsic", "intrinsic" or "inherent"? What follow-up actions does this classification determine?

blocks.zh: 矽油用量需要「最小化」但又要「保證機械性」——在 CDMO 的日常生產中，如何建立矽油用量的控制與監測機制？
blocks.en: Silicone oil usage must be "minimized" yet still "ensure mechanical function". In day-to-day CDMO production, how do you establish a control and monitoring mechanism for silicone oil usage?

blocks.zh: 如果趨勢圖顯示每月的 100% 檢查拒絕率在過去 6 個月持續上升（但未超出行動限），你會採取什麼措施？
blocks.en: If the trend chart shows the monthly 100% inspection rejection rate rising steadily over the past 6 months (but without exceeding the action limit), what would you do?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 目視檢查是機率性過程：150 µm 是可靠偵測門檻（70% PoD），小於 200 µm 的粒子即使在合格系統中仍可能漏過——預防比偵測更重要
blocks.en: Visual inspection is a probabilistic process: 150 µm is the reliable detection threshold (70% PoD), and particles smaller than 200 µm can still be missed even in a qualified system, so prevention matters more than detection

blocks.zh: 三層檢查流程：100% 目視檢查 → AQL 驗收抽樣（ANSI/ASQ Z1.4）→ DIP 補充測試，每層各有其目的與法規要求
blocks.en: Three-layer inspection flow: 100% visual inspection → AQL acceptance sampling (ANSI/ASQ Z1.4) → supplemental testing for DIP, each layer with its own purpose and regulatory requirements

blocks.zh: 粒子分類決定調查深度：外源性最高警戒；內源性需系統性預防；固有性需臨床風險評估
blocks.en: Particle classification determines the depth of investigation: extrinsic is the highest alert; intrinsic needs systematic prevention; inherent needs a clinical risk assessment

blocks.zh: AQL 保護廠商（生產者風險）；UQL 保護患者（消費者風險）——必須同時考量兩者
blocks.en: AQL protects the manufacturer (producer's risk); UQL protects the patient (consumer's risk); both must be considered together

blocks.zh: 趨勢分析是生命週期方法的閉環機制，是 CDMO 持續改善的數據基礎，也是監管機構 PAI 常見查核重點
blocks.en: Trending is the closed-loop mechanism of the life cycle approach, the data foundation for CDMO continual improvement, and a frequent focus of regulatory PAI inspections
